description: List notes in the vault. Optionally filter by directory prefix or by frontmatter tag. Pass `includeStubs: false` to exclude unresolved wiki-link targets (nodes with `frontmatter._stub: true`) and see only real on-disk notes.

directory.description: Restrict to notes under this subdirectory prefix.

includeStubs.description: Default `true`. Set `false` to exclude unresolved wiki-link targets.

tag.description: Restrict to notes containing this frontmatter tag.

name: list_notes
